steps.text: Get 65/82/85 Farming at Tithe farm first

steps.title: Clean out your inventory to just …
steps.text: Clean out your inventory to just your rune pouch (air, earth, law), staff of fire, water runes, and coins

steps.title: Get 1020 noted pineapples from Brimhaven. …
steps.text: Get 1020 noted pineapples from Brimhaven. — Buy them at charters, note at the farming patch

steps.title: Buy a seed box from Tithe …
steps.text: Buy a seed box from Tithe Farm

steps.title: Get a Kharedst's memoirs again
steps.text: Get a Kharedst's memoirs again

steps.title: wear it if you don't have …
steps.text: wear it if you don't have it. This will be your Hosidius teleport for Farming if you are blackjacking

steps.title: Get a rune pickaxe from a …
steps.text: Get a rune pickaxe from a shop

steps.title: Mine 1,700 volcanic ash. Once done …
steps.text: Mine 1,700 volcanic ash. Once done you can alch the pickaxe

steps.title: Go to each compost bin around …
steps.text: Go to each compost bin around the world you have access to and fill them with pineapples. When they are done you can come back to harvest them. — Use the volcanic ash on the bin before harvesting the compost. — You will want to get moving on this even though you don't have herb seeds yet so that you can clear up the 2 inventory slots for pineapples and volcanic ash. — Keep 15 inventory slots open until you are done making compost.

steps.title: Put away your graceful, get out …
steps.text: Put away your graceful, get out your rogues set

steps.title: Move your house to Pollnivneach if …
steps.text: Move your house to Pollnivneach if you plan to blackjack, otherwise put it in Hosidius

steps.title: Drop your water runes (They won't …
steps.text: Drop your water runes (They won't be needed since you have an Ardougne portal in your house)

steps.title: Go to the Farming Guild. — …
steps.text: Go to the Farming Guild. — Battlefront teleport in your house takes you nearby

steps.title: Inventory check: Jangerberry seed, Snape grass …
steps.text: Inventory check: Jangerberry seed, Snape grass seed, Strawberry seed, Watermelon seed, Limpwurt seed, Whiteberry seed, Kwuarm seed, Avantoe seed, Irit seed, Toadflax seed, Ranarr seed, Harralander seed, Lantadyme seed, Snapdragon seed, Seed box, Looting bag, Coins, Rune pouch

steps.title: Instead of doing master farmers right …
steps.text: Instead of doing master farmers right away, blackjack or thieve Ardougne knights until you have around 2,000,000 coins coins. That gives 500,000 coins for Smithing, 750,000 coins for Construction, then 750,000 coins for anything else like runes and death storage fees.

steps.title: If you want to get no-fail …
steps.text: If you want to get no-fail master farmers, the thieving cape is easier to obtain than completing the Ardougne hard diary since it has high requirements. If you wish to avoid post-99 experience though you could go out of your way for the diary.

steps.title: Once you reach your goal level …
steps.text: Once you reach your goal level (after acquiring ~2,000,000 coins coins or a specific level you want), you can start on master farmers. — Draynor Village is a good place to thieve master farmers as you can buy wines at the shop there. Your Draynor Manor teleport will get you close. There are plenty of other location options though.

steps.title: Once you have all the herb …
steps.text: Once you have all the herb seeds needed, clean up your inventory and move on to the other skills. Just keep your seed box on you with the seeds you are planning to farm, then bag the noted herbs.

steps.title: Farm limpwurt roots and white berries …
steps.text: Farm limpwurt roots and white berries to match your kwuarms and cadantines. Also get 20 extra limpwurt roots for Temple of Ikov

steps.title: At level 78 you unlock Dorgesh-Kaan …
steps.text: At level 78 you unlock Dorgesh-Kaan Rich Chests. This is a very good alternative to blackjacking for fast experience after you get the money you need. — With more effort, you can alch and cut the loot from the chests for very efficient money and Magic/Crafting experience. While small, this would add up significantly if you are going to 99.
